mapper.insert: insert into operation( id, operation_type, status, resource_type, resource_id, risk_level, impact_json, progress, result_json, error_json, revert_operation_id, automation_session_id, agent_command_id, correlation_id, actor, idempotency_key, version, created_at, updated_at, completed_at ) values ( #{id}, #{operationType}, #{status}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{riskLevel}, #{impactJson}, #{progress}, #{resultJson}, #{errorJson}, #{revertOperationId}, #{automationSessionId}, #{agentCommandId}, #{correlationId}, #{actor}, #{idempotencyKey}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, null )
mapper.update: update operation set status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, result_json = #{resultJson}, error_json = #{errorJson}, revert_operation_id = #{revertOperationId}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: select operation_id, sequence, event_type, actor, detail_json, occurred_at from operation_event where operation_id = #{operationId} order by sequence asc
select coalesce(max(sequence), 0) + 1 from operation_event where operation_id = #{operationId}
